title: coord's key directory nests groups as deep as GitLab's, and a group's keys are written by its own operators and those of the groups above it
goal: coord.py serve reads a key file at any depth of --keys: DIR/G1/.../OPERATOR is the operator G1/.../OPERATOR, whose groups are G1, G1/G2 and so on; a claim or put of a key under group/G1/.../GN/ is accepted from an operator whose group path is that path or one of its ancestors and exits 1 for any other caller; a key under team/NAME/ keeps its rule, NAME read as a group one level deep; flat operators and keys outside group/ and team/ behave as before; every event a served caller leaves names the full operator path

run:
import sys,os,json,tempfile,subprocess
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
import atexit
kd=os.path.join(d,"keys")
def key(p,t):
    f=os.path.join(kd,*p.split("/")); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(f),exist_ok=True); open(f,"w").write(t); os.chmod(f,0o600); return f
def serve(*extra):
    sv=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py","--store",os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"),"serve","--bind","127.0.0.1:0","--keys",kd,*extra],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,text=True); atexit.register(sv.kill)
    return sv, sv.stdout.readline().split("serving")[1].strip()
a=key("corp/ops/jan.kowalski","ka-placeholder"); b=key("corp/dev/anna.nowak","kb-placeholder"); cc=key("corp/ops/edge/piotr.nowak","kc-placeholder"); t=key("ops/ewa.nowak","kd-placeholder"); f=key("flat.op","kf-placeholder")
sv,url=serve()
co=lambda k,*x: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py","--url",url,"--key-file",k,*x],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
put=lambda k,kk: co(k,"put",kk,"--value","{}","--revision","0").returncode
r=[put(a,"group/corp/ops/x"),put(a,"group/corp/ops/edge/y"),put(cc,"group/corp/ops/z"),put(b,"group/corp/ops/w"),put(t,"team/ops/v"),put(b,"team/ops/u"),put(f,"free/x"),put(a,"free/y"),put(f,"group/corp/ops/q")]
assert co(a,"claim","group/corp/ops/c","--ttl","60","--holder","h").returncode==0
ev=json.loads(co(a,"wait","--since","0","--timeout","0").stdout)["events"]; sv.terminate()
assert r==[0,0,1,1,0,1,0,0,1], r
assert any(e["fields"].get("operator")=="corp/ops/jan.kowalski" for e in ev), ev

clauses.clause: coord.py serve reads a key file at any depth of --keys: DIR/G1/.../OPERATOR is the operator G1/.../OPERATOR, whose groups are G1, G1/G2 and so on
a claim or put of a key under group/G1/.../GN/ is accepted from an operator whose group path is that path or one of its ancestors and exits 1 for any other caller
a key under team/NAME/ keeps its rule, NAME read as a group one level deep
flat operators and keys outside group/ and team/ behave as before
every event a served caller leaves names the full operator path

notes: Research 2026-11-08 (kb public/gitlab/codeowners.md, Groups and subgroups): GitLab nests groups up to 20 levels on every tier and advises five or fewer; members inherit into subgroups. A coord group path deeper than 20 levels matches no GitLab group, so refusing it is consistent with the forge.
